compute.cost_note: one variance_audit pass per version; tier 1 is stdlib, --tier2 needs spaCy

do_not_use_when: you have only one before/after pair (use before_after_restoration or known_editor_profile)
you want a provenance verdict for any version; the report names where signals moved, not why

inputs.target: a JSON list of {label, path} draft versions in chronological order (--versions-json)

purpose: Version-aware stylometric trajectory across a chronological sequence of drafts. Runs variance_audit signals on each version and reports per-version metrics, adjacent-version deltas, the inflection point per signal, and a heuristic per-signal shape (stable_throughout, gradual_drift, sudden_shift, restored_after_drift).
use_when: you have several dated versions of one piece and want to see where in the revision arc signals moved
checking whether later edits restored what an earlier pass flattened
